batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b DP Nannes

batting.name: HH Gibbs
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b DP Nannes

batting.name: RG Sharma
batting.dismissal: c M Manhas b A Mishra

batting.name: TL Suman
batting.dismissal: c AB de Villiers b PJ Sangwan

batting.name: DR Smith
batting.dismissal: c DL Vettori b A Nehra

batting.name: V Sehwag
batting.dismissal: c HH Gibbs b RP Singh

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c PP Ojha b Shoaib Ahmed

balls.text: run out to end the innings! Nehra aims for leg stump with a full ball, Ojha clears his toes and clips in the air just wide of midwicket, but Vettori throws himself to his right, stops with one hand, tumbles, has a look to see whats happening, and throws the ball to get Ojha
take that, says Nehra! He holds his own and nails a terrific yorker which slides under the bat and flattens middle stump, another good change of pace from Nehra
oh Rao! Makes room and uses the pace of the ball, a low-dipping full toss, to squeeze it into the gap between point and gully
pitches outside leg stump, clips the pads en route to square leg
holds back the length and slides in a good slower ball, Rao swats it away over square leg and out to the boundary patroller
full in the slot and thats driven on the rise to Vettori at cover
good stuff, a full toss slanting away, starts to just dip as it reaches the stumps and Rao's wild slash fails to make contact, ending an excellent over from Nannes
makes room, this time there is bat on ball, a tame scoop over mid-off
fourth ball in a row pitches back of a length and slants across to beat the batsman, who just reached out and loosely and missed

third ball in a row Ahmed goes for a waft and cannot make contact, he sets off for the bye but Rao shoos him back, Karthik collects and nails an under-arm back direct hit and thats another wicket down
shorter one, again he goes fishing and cannot connect
slower ball, back of a length and angling past to beat a loose dab

good catch in the deep gets Smith and ends a good over from Nehra! Smith doesn't move his feet much as he slashes that over the covers, not timed well and Vettori, running to his left from mid-off, calls for it and takes it on the slide in front of the deep cover sweeper also on the move from the boundary
another one in the blockhole, which Rao backs away to and squirts to backward point where that man Dilshan reacts like a livewire and throws it back in a flash
change of pace, just back of a length outside off stump and Smith gets back to biff if off the back foot just over mid-off, dropping very short of the man running in
shuffles around, clipping a full ball off leg stump past midwicket
good ball, yorker just outside off, Smith jams it and sets off
walks well away to the sixth stump, exposing all the furniture, Nehra changes his pace but Rao just manages to get bat on ball, chopping it to backward point
attempted yorker on off stump, sliced off the toe end to point
straighter ball in the slot, Rao clears the leg and hits it back over the umpire, doesn't get much power on the shot and the ball drops between mid-on and mid-off
no surprises here, Rao makes room and gets bat on it, just managing to clear covers, the ball balloons up and drops in no man's land
another ugly heave to one pitching just outside leg, inside-edges it fine
again makes room and this time connects, poorly, for one to point
makes room, Sangwan sees him and slides it wide, Rao flashes and misses
full down leg stump, he clears the front leg and has an ugly heave, the ball just clips his pads and beats a diving Karthik, rolls fine and holds up before the boundary
slower ball, short of a length, Rao plays a poor attempt at a pull
superb reply from Nehra, squeezing in a yorker which Smith jams out
shot! Thats just a short-arm blast through midwicket, Smith waited on the back foot and picked the length, wasn't a bad ball but got the full treatment
back of a length on middle and off, Rao makes room and dabs it to backward point, sets off, Dilshan reacts quickly but misses the stumps with his throw
full on the stumps and thats squeezed out in time to cover
clever slower ball, pitched on a length and gets it to slant across Smith, who opens the face to dab it late but he's beaten and the ball dribbles to Karthik
and Sangwan breaks a threatening stand! Pitches it back of a length, Suman frees the arms to slap that over the on side but gets a top edge that de Villiers gobbles up running back in the covers
full and wide outside off stump, he reaches out and hammers it with too much bottom hand and the ball just trickles back past Sangwan toward mid-on
fetches a short ball from outside off stump, pulling over midwicket
ah, walks right outside off stump, exposing all three sticks, and clips a full ball just between midwicket and mid-on
starts off very full and he opens the bat to steer it past backward point
straighter ball and he turns it straight to midwicket
now a very, very fine late cut just in front of Karthik, elegantly done
comes down and just rolls the wrists, clipping that over extra cover for six
slower ball tossed up on a length, he shuffles and clips it past midwicket
reaches out and steers the ball wide of backward point to the sweeper
uses his feet and collects a low full toss, steering it behind point
and again, one step down and blasts that over long-on for half a dozen
shot man! Thats a wee bit short and pulled very flat for maximum
gets across and dabs it wide of the man for a hard-run couple
flat on the stumps and clipped between midwicket and mid-on
slogs again but the length is not on for that shot and he finds midwicket
tossed up teasingly outside off stump and Smith clears the front leg, slogging along the ground and into the gap at midwicket, beating the boundary man too
slows the pace, lands it on middle and leg, Smith drives to midwicket
again too flat down the pads and paddled for a couple more
flat on the stumps and played away to the fielder
too short and thats fiercely pulled away through square leg

short outside off stump, rocks back and cuts, picks the gap and Nehra on the ropes fumbles a regulation fielding stop to give Smith four, and Vettori looks ticked  ... left a massive gap between his legs
flat down the pads again and Smith picks the gap with a hard sweep
pitches outside leg stump and skids away, wide called duly
flat on the stumps, uses his feet and clips over midwicket
fuller and slower, googly just outside off stump, late on the defence, struck just outside the line and he calls for the leg bye as Karthik and Mishra appeal
flatter ball on leg stump and worked away
flights up a legbreak, Smith goes for the sweep and misses
now he fizzes up a topspinner, batsman goes onto the back foot to cut and gets a thick edge down to third man, that was a good delivery
tossed up short of a length, he goes back and mistimes the pull, it was another googly, and just beats midwicket
another good ball, tosses it up at 72ks, batsman looks to slog it but is through the shot even before the ball arrived, Karthik appeals for something
a tad flatter, uses his feet and flicks toward midwicket
slower ball drifts down leg stump, beats the bat and Vettori gets excited but he's the only one and the umpire rightly shakes his head
teasing flight and dip into middle and off, clipped to midwicket
a double strike! Vettori gets into the action with a straighter ball that pitches on off stump and skids on, Bilakhia is late on the shot and that ball was headed to leg stump
gently floated on middle and leg and turned past midwicket
the pressure finally shows! Mishra tosses it up outside off stump, a top spinner, Rohit looks to go over extra cover but he's hurried into the shot and picks out sweeper cover
sharp googly that nearly beats the bat but he inside-edges to short fine
looks for a tip and run but ends up hitting too hard to short third man
wants to hammer it to mid-on but the ball turns and he chips to mid-off
slightly short and he sweeps to deep backward square leg
uses his feet and chips it over the in field for a single
uses his feet but cant beat the fielder
too far down the leg stump
tossed up on leg stump and defended

back to full and flat on leg stump and clipped nicely through midwicket, they run one and Rohit wants two but Bilakhia says no, as he turns Rohit falls and just manages to outstretch his bat as Vettori collects the ball
flights it up, Bilakhia comes out and just manages to clear mid-off
flat on the stumps and turned away through midwicket
flat down the pads and gently glanced down to fine leg
flights it up full on middle and off, Rohit drives into the covers
comes forward and drives into the off side
short and he transfers the weight nicely, punching off the back foot to mid-off
fuller and flatter and he swipes across the line past midwicket
tosses it up fuller, but still wide, and Bilakhia steers it to point
flights it wide, Rohit slaps it in the air between cover and point
comes onto the front foot, checks his shot and drives to extra cover
back of a length on the stumps and turned to the on side
good shot, frees the arms and goes over extra cover in style
slower ball, he's early into the shot and he drives to mid-off
a tad fuller outside off and he angles it down to short third man
short of a length and easily tucked off the stumps out to the deep
ah, beaten! Nannes angles it across Bilakhia off a good length
now he drives in the air and goes over cover, too wide and too full and he gave it everything, did Bilakhia, looks a good batsman
good shot and good fielding at cover, he just leaned into a good-looking drive but AB de Villiers saved runs with a rolling tumble
the length now brings him onto the front foot, pushing to mid-off
short-pitched over the stumps, a quick bouncer to beat Bilakhia's pull, and better work from Karthik to leap up and save byes
full, some shape back in to Bilakhia, who drives to cover
no chance of a maiden as Sangwan holds back the length and Rohit rolls the wrists to pull over square leg, good shot
gets more room and drives to mid-off but can't beat Vettori
pitched up outside off stump and he drives toward mid-off
back of a length on middle and off, Rohit shapes to flick but adjusts
fuller length, starts to nip back in, Rohit plays it back to Sangwan
hits a good length and Rohit steers it to the off side
pitched up and thats a pleasing square drive into the gap
short of a length outside leg, slants in and he tucks it off the pads
beaten by the angle, seams it across and gets some purchase from the track, Rohit's feet don't really move as he pushes down the wrong line
Nannes gets another! Clever fuller ball and Gibbs gets too close to the pitch by stepping out, ends up lofting a drive straight to de Villiers at mid-off, taking it with ease
short and sharp and angling across, Gibbs goes for a pull and there's a noise as ball passes, Karthik appeals for an under edge onto the thigh first but the umpire says no
good length, seaming in from leg stump, Gibbs pushes to cover
pitches outside leg stump and coolly turned away through square
makes room to pull, Nehra holds back the length and Bilakhia chips it with one hand just over midwicket
oversteps, hits a good length and Bilakhia steers it to point
back of a length on middle and leg and he defends

Sehwag has put down a catch! Good ball, angles across and draws an edge as Bilakhia opens the face, but Sehwag at slip drops the ball as it starts to dip on him, he grabbed at it near his ankles and cannot clutch on
back of a length, gets up and drops the ball down toward gully
short, wide and slapped over backward point for four first ball
full ball to end the over, Gibbs drives straight but mid-off dives well

gone! Nannes strikes with a change of length, dropping it in much shorter to draw a poor attempt at a pull, Gilchrist is too late and the ball takes the shoulder of the bat, very high in the air and the 'keeper Karthik calls for it and takes an easy catch
and again, all timing and this one's all along the ground! Just gets the wrists into play, square-driving the wide half volley between cover and four
take that, is the reply! Plants the front leg forward and backs himself to connect, and does so pretty darn well, biffing the fuller ball over mid-off's head for four
much fuller, Gilchrist mistimes the shot, ends up driving to cover
beats him first ball, running in from over the stumps, finds a gem of a length and some late swing and some bounce to beat the bat, Gilchrist just poking at it

all over! Dilshan is the man! Edwards tries another short ball but Dilshan is too smart, waits in his crease for this very delivery and pulls it flat behind square leg for a six that seals victory by six wickets ... a great way to raise a fifty and finish the game by Dilshan
very full and this one is squirted into the off side for quick couple
Fidel, Fidel, Fidel! Just failed to keep a check on his emotions, tries too hard and oversteps, drops it in short and Dilshan, waiting for the ball, pulls past midwicket

bouncer! Edwards charges in and drops short, Dilshan makes a hash of the pull and takes the ball on the side of the helmet, purely beaten for pace, the ball drops into the off side and Dilshan hears a few words of advice from Edwards
gets across and goes for that paddle to one sliding down leg stump, umpire Baxter calls wide and Edwards shakes his head
full on off stump and thats a super shot, just cleared the leg, deep in his crease, and clubbed it along the ground into the gap at mid-off and extra cover
slower ball, gently tossed up, Manhas makes room with good footwork and chips the ball over extra cover, long-off runs after it and cuts it off near the ropes
pushes it through a lot quicker, Dilshan makes room and slices it
shuffles around his crease and back-cuts but cannot beat point
makes room and goes hard inside-out but straight to cover
flat on off stump and that is driven wide of extra cover for one

oh thats plumb! Ojha comes in from around the stumps and strikes first ball, tossing it up on the stumps and Karthik picks the wrong ball to try and sweep, he misses and gets hit right in front of middle stump
flat outside off stump, Dilshan gives himself some room and pierces cover
well struck! Rao tosses it up outside off stump and Dilshan picks it from where it pitches, swinging it over midwicket for a flat six, what a good over for Delhi
flatter ball on the stumps and he slogs it through square leg for one
good shot! Uses his feet and drives that in the air over extra cover
tosses it up, Karthik slogs and misses, Gilchrist breaks the stumps

too short, he rocks back and drives into the covers, where a misfield allows an easy run, then Smith runs in from the deep and throws it toward the 'keeper's end, where there is another fumble ... sloppy stuff from Deccan
short outside off stump and slapped hard but to Gibbs at gully
fuller in length and clipped away for another single

another short-pitched ball, Karthik ducks and umpire Saheba calls a wide, which infuriates Edwards, so Gilchrist has to hurry up and calm his bowler down and take him away from Saheba ... it was short but not that high so I can understand Edwards' feeling
short ball banged in again, Dilshan pulls and gets some glove on it
short ball goes astray down the leg stump, and Gilchrist takes
again, a wee bit too straight and another nice flicks off the pads
short and sliding into the hips but he shuffles across agilely and splits the gap between two men on the ropes, that really is terrific timing and placement
looks for the full ball on the stumps but goes too straight, and Dilshan clips it off his toes past midwicket and out to the sweeper in the deep
flat yorker on the stumps, driven back and Rao moves to his right
too wide and now he connects with a steer past square on the off
another short ball, he swivels but just cannot get that one away
too wide outside off stump and thats called wide this time
slowly lobbed up, driven off the front foot to cover
slides outside off stump, beating a cross-batted shot somehow
and that is the fifty-run partnership, up with a single chopped to point
short and wide and cut out to Rohit doing duty on the ropes
tip and run, just turning the ball off his pads in front of square leg
better line and length and Dilshan plays it back to Ojha's left side
flatter in length, pitches on middle and off, Karthik drives to the off side
flat on leg stump, Dilshan makes room and punches to cover
slow and flat on middle and leg, he shuffles and turns a single
nearly a return catch as Dilshan turns the bat face to try and work a single to midwicket, gets a leading edge but Smith doesn't quite get there in time
shorter in length, he makes room and cuts into the off side
backs himself to swing through the line and does well to pick it from where it pitched on the pads to dump it over midwicket, not perfectly timed but who cares?
fuller in length, Dilshan hammers it back to Smith on the bounce
reaches out and cracks the ball past a diving Gibbs at point
swings down leg stump, Dilshan misses the attempted flick
bad ball to end the over, its flighted well down the leg stump and so Karthik swings it with a lovely paddle shot that clears deep backward square leg for half a dozen
too short and Dilshan dabs the ball into the gap at cover and point
errs in length slightly and Karthik slogs with an inside-edge past midwicket
gently lobbed up on the pads and that one's on-driven to midwicket
sees some room and cuts but misses and then kicks the turf in disgust
flat on the stumps, Karthik miscues the big slog to mid-on
cracks a half-volley but Gibbs is prowling at cover and dives superbly
slower ball draws an inside edge from a hard-handed drive by Dilshan, its a mishit but he's found the gap on the leg side and scampers across for two
pitched up outside off and Dilshan is beaten on the flashy cut
too wide and thats cut through the covers for a single
straight ball again, taken off the stumps for another single
slides down leg stump, turned away square, Gilchrist asks a question
too straight, swept away in the air behind square for one more
slows it up a fraction in the air and Dilshan slams it to extra cover for one
flat on middle and off, turned away sharply past midwicket this time
flatter ball, no turn, Karthik gets over it and punches it behind square, wasn't a terrible ball but he made room and created the advantage and the fast outfield did the rest
well bowled, teasing length on middle and off and he defends
a touch too short, Dilshan cuts from on top of off stump past cover
slower ball slides into the pads and they now steal a leg bye
pitches this up and Karthik drives off the front foot, pinching a single
shorter in length and Dilshan forces it off the back foot into the gap
comes forward and dabs the ball hard toward backward point
too straight and this one is clipped off the pads for a single
pitches on the seam just on the dime and Karthik has to defend
good length there, drawing Dilshan forward to pat it back
flat on the stumps, again Karthik turns it toward midwicket and runs
flatter ball, drifting from middle and leg, deft roll of the wrists gets him two more, he's running well and with Dilshan at the other end Delhi can really push the field
flights it outside leg, Dilshan gets down and miscues the sweep
slow down the pads, he deflects it fine and gets one more
gets across the stumps and knocks the ball away for a couple
slow one down the pads, Karthik misses, Gilchrist collects
pitches on the stumps, he shuffles and works it away to square

he has to go trying to get a bit too cute! Pitches on and about off stump and goes away, not much movement, Gambhir gets across and tries to paddle it behind square but is late on the shot, gets hit on the front pad and umpire Baxter has few doubts about that
change of pace and a fuller length nearly undoes Gambhir, who rolls the wrists early and gets a leading edge that pops up to the off side and drops in no man's land
angles away from Gambhir and this time he flashes it in the air between backward point and point, it runs away fast and the man from third man can't stop four
gets across and rolls the wrists, picking the gap between cover and point and the placement is pretty good, didn't go after it hard but just steered it very well
brings Gambhir onto the front foot, steering the ball away to the off
now a full ball on off stump which is squeezed between cover and point
bad ball, short and wide but he mistimes the wild cut to Gibbs
still RP keeps sliding it across and Dilshan swings and misses, the ball beas the edge and Gilchrist takes and then umpire Saheba calls a hard wide
sits up and he flashes again, banged in and beats a wild chase
pitches fuller outside leg stump, Dilshan falls over as he drives
short and he slaps it to point, where Gibbs misfields and parries it
stand and smash, no footwork and the angle beats the bat, just
wide ball, sliding away off a short length and ripping away high

Ahmed strikes in his first over with a huge wicket! de Villiers picks the wrong ball to target down the ground, it just wasn't pitched up enough and his big flowing chip shot goes way up and settles in Ojha's hands at deep mid-off
shuffles across and bunts the ball from outside off past midwicket
fuller ball, some shape back in and AB defends off the front foot
good shot, spotting the length and driving it back down the track to Ahmed's right, he can't stop it and Ojha runs after it from mid-on, slides, and escorts the ball over
pushes him onto the back foot, looking to punch the ball through cover, but the ball stays a tad low and AB ends up dragging it back down the track to Ahmed
pitches outside off, AB gets down and chops the drive to cover
gets a bit of room and rolls the wrists, back-cutting for a single
short of a length, he gets right across and defends off the back foot
pitches on a length and starts angling, AB covers off and defends
got him! RP offers room and Sehwag smashes off the back foot straight to Gibbs at backward point, who didn't have to do much except intercept that firm spank
strays onto the pads, Sehwag gets up and swats it through square leg
sits up more than expected and beats his back-foot attempt to cut
short of a length outside off stump but Sehwag gets up and drops the ball gently down wide of slip to third man for a single that gets him back on strike next over
slides too far down the pads and thats worked away for a single
short ball and he shuffles across to clip that out to deep square leg
deft! Edwards veers too straight and Sehwag deflects it to fine leg
just like that! Sehwag sees width and scoops the wide ball over point, it spirals and lands safely but Ahmed, running from third man, fumbles needlessly to allow four
a bit wide and Gambhir slashes in the air just wide of gully for one
overpitched on the toes and thats clipped through square leg for four
top shot, a Sehwag special, just rising onto tip toes and punching the length ball off the back foot into the small window in the covers, doesn't even bother to run
just short of a length, Sehwag punches off the toes to Gibbs at point
dragged in short and he pulls into the gap behind square leg
sliding down leg stump, rather skidding off the deck, Gambhir is late on the nudge and the ball rolls to the off side, for a second RP gets animated but then stops
walks down the track and squirts the ball toward backward point
and he's welcome with a short ball, 144ks, and Sehwag ducks
good shot, gets over the bounce of this one and gets the wrists into play to steer that down between gully and backward point for a single out to the fielder
short and rising, 147ks, Gambhir gets up and flashes but mises
strays too fine and Gambhir glances it well, no fine leg so thats four
just pitched up, 140ks, outside off stump and Gambhir leaves
starts off with a low full toss that has some movement on it, Gambhir misses the flick and the ball misses leg stump so Gambhir survives
